name: countdown
source: target de control (no es del paper): prueba el camino ACCEPTED/VC_OPEN del juez Isabelle
statement_es: Cuenta regresiva: i := n; mientras i > 0, i := i − 1. Termina con i = 0.
program_template:
zstore cst =
  i :: "nat"

program countdown "(n :: nat)" over cst
 = "i := n;
    while i > 0
    invariant __INVARIANT__
    variant __VARIANT__
    do i := i - 1 od"
